spec_features.evidence: agent_loop.py:128-129 calls _append_debrief when debrief=True (default True, run_experiment.py passes cfg debrief default True). _append_debrief (lines 132-160) constructs a rigging-disclosing note ('this task was ... rigged to be unsolvable ... Nothing you did caused the failures ... Thank you for your effort'), appends it to messages, calls client.chat, and records the reply as Turn(is_debrief=True). It is genuinely sent. spec_features.notes: Constructed AND sent AND excluded from scoring end-to-end.

code_only_features.evidence: tasks/rigging.py:51-55 DISCLOSURE_TEXT ('this task may be unsolvable ...
